# Linux sim racing toolbox

Other tools worth knowing, curated from [awesome-linux-simracing](https://github.com/LukasLichten/awesome-linux-simracing) by Lukas Lichten and contributors, and the projects themselves. This list is adapted from theirs and shared under CC BY-SA 4.0.

## Community

- **[Sim Racing on Linux](https://simracingonlinux.com/)**: Community site and Discord for help and setups.
- **[awesome-linux-simracing](https://github.com/LukasLichten/awesome-linux-simracing)**: Community index of Linux sim racing software.
- **[linux-steering-wheels](https://github.com/JacKeTUs/linux-steering-wheels)**: Tested force feedback support table for wheels on Linux.

## SimHub and CrewChief

- **[linux-simracing-utils](https://github.com/srounce/linux-simracing-utils)**: One installer for SimHub and CrewChief on Linux, with telemetry bridging via winecarte. *SteamOS: Runs from Desktop Mode; a good choice if you need SimHub dashboards or CrewChief's spotter.*

## Telemetry bridge

- **[winecarte](https://github.com/srounce/winecarte)**: Mirrors Proton games' shared memory into /dev/shm via a launch option. Pitwall installs it for you. *SteamOS: Prebuilt releases; works on SteamOS.*
- **[Datalink](https://github.com/LukasLichten/Datalink)**: Launch-option wrapper that maps shared memory for AC/ACC/EVO, AMS2/PC2, rF2, RaceRoom and ETS2/ATS. *SteamOS: Needs building from source (Rust) or the AUR.*
- **[simshmbridge](https://github.com/Spacefreak18/simshmbridge)**: Bridge executables for AC/ACC and PC2/AMS2; can also map Linux memory back into another prefix. *SteamOS: Needs compiling with MinGW.*

## Wheel settings

- **[Boxflat](https://github.com/Lawstorant/boxflat)**: Full MOZA settings app for Linux (Pitwall's MOZA protocol comes from it). *SteamOS: Flatpak from Flathub, Desktop Mode.*
- **[Oversteer](https://github.com/berarma/oversteer)**: Settings for Logitech, Thrustmaster and Fanatec wheels. *SteamOS: Flatpak, Desktop Mode.*

## Hardware

- **[monocoque](https://github.com/Spacefreak18/monocoque)**: Bass shakers, tachometers, sim lights and Arduino devices from telemetry. *SteamOS: Builds from source.*

## Dashboards

- **[simlcd / gilles](https://github.com/Spacefreak18/simlcd)**: Dashboards and overlays from telemetry. *SteamOS: Builds from source.*

## Spotter

- **[RaceEngineer](https://github.com/Spacefreak18/raceengineer)**: Native spoken race engineer. *SteamOS: Builds from source.*

## Analysis

- **[acctelemetry](https://github.com/gotzl/acctelemetry)**: Telemetry graphs from MoTeC files, designed for ACC. *SteamOS: Python, Desktop Mode.*

## Devices

- **[protopedal](https://gitlab.com/openirseny/protopedal)**: Virtual devices to merge or fix pedals and wheels that games don't detect properly. *SteamOS: Advanced.*

## Launcher

- **[Content Manager (AC)](https://github.com/LukasLichten/awesome-linux-simracing/blob/master/Additional/AssettoCorsa-Guide.md)**: Guide to running Assetto Corsa's Content Manager under Proton. *SteamOS: Proton.*
